title: [PC] DOJI RUN: a cyberpunk stock market roguelite. Playtest is open on Steam
author: DojiRun
selftext:
Hey everyone, I'm a solo dev and the DOJI RUN playtest is open on Steam. It's free and developed in conjuntion with Claude Code, used for coding, test harness, data analysis and initial balancing.

It's a cyberpunk stock market roguelite. You play cards onto a live chart, trade your way to the weekly goal, and fight a boss every Friday.

The goal of this playtest is simple: gather data and feedback so I can release a polished demo soon. I want to know what's fun, what's confusing, and what I should cut. Be honest, I can take it.

Sharing gameplay data is optional and anonymous (no name, no Steam ID). There's a "Send a Note" button on the pause menu if you want to tell me something mid-run.

Steam page, hit Join the Playtest: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5260350/Doji\_Run/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5260350/Doji_Run/)



Thank you for playing, it helps a lot.
